dispute_evidence.claim: Plan Task 9 requires the OAuth callback's success leg to return a redirect to /settings?google=connected. The implementation does exactly that: c.redirect(destination.toString(), 302). However exports.default.fetch(...) -- the cloudflare:workers entrypoint this suite calls -- FOLLOWS redirects by default, like a real Fetcher. The followed request for /settings has no Worker-side handler (it is intentionally a client-only SPA route -- that is the entire point of this phase), so it lands on app.notFound() (src/worker/index.ts, 404) and the final response carries no Location header. Therefore no implementation of a genuine 3xx redirect can satisfy these assertions as written. The implementer proved this by temporarily registering a /settings handler returning 599 and observing the test see 599 -- the harness had silently re-dispatched the followed request. That probe was reverted and src/worker/index.ts is absent from the attempt diff.
dispute_evidence.proposed_resolution: Amend the assertions to observe the redirect without auto-following it (e.g. construct the request with redirect: "manual"), which is the standard Fetch-API mechanism for inspecting a 3xx response's own status and Location. A test-authoring fix; the Task 9 implementation itself should not change.
